output.answer: IBM's most recent full-year revenue is $67.5 billion for fiscal year 2025 (year ended December 31, 2025) — $67,535 million as reported in its FY2025 Form 10-K, up 7.6% from $62,753 million in FY2024 (about 6% growth at constant currency). IBM guides to more than 5% constant-currency revenue growth for full-year 2026. IBM's fiscal year ends December 31, so no newer full-year figure exists as of today; the next full-year number (FY2026) will be reported in January 2027.
caveats: FY2026 revenue is not yet known — IBM only guided to more than 5% constant-currency revenue growth for 2026 at current FX rates (January 28, 2026); quarterly 2026 results during the year could change the full-year picture.
The headline growth rate differs by basis: 7.6% as reported vs. 6% adjusted for currency (constant currency), per the 10-K.

key_facts.fact: IBM full-year 2025 revenue was $67,535 million (about $67.5 billion), per its FY2025 Form 10-K.
FY2025 revenue grew 7.6% year over year from FY2024 revenue of $62,753 million; growth was 6% adjusted for currency.

In its Q4/full-year 2025 release (January 28, 2026), IBM reported full-year revenue of $67.5 billion, up 8% (6% at constant currency), and guided to more than 5% constant-currency revenue growth for full-year 2026.
